name: Education / Exam Prep
who: Teaching a subject, exam prep, lecture-style content.

structure.job: the question the exam actually asks
the whole topic in one picture
one concept per beat, diagram on screen
the map again, now filled in

retention_risks: talking over a slide with 40 words
hook_patterns: the exam question in the first 3 s
'this one concept is worth N marks'
the topic map before the detail
never: never more than 7 words per card
no decorations that move during explanation
note: Numbers here are starting defaults chosen from the category's conventions, NOT measurements. Add 3 real videos with `sutra evidence add` before quoting them anywhere.
